title: Pisces sailed to the windiest planet.
old_caption: Pisces put a sail on a rocket to feel the wind on Neptune. Turns out it's the windiest planet around. Virgo talked it through the spin, one breath at a time. Who's your calm in a storm?

title: Sag is going to the centre of the galaxy.
old_caption: Sag flew all the way to the center of the galaxy, saw the most incredible view there is, and had nobody in the passenger seat but a buckled-in backpack. So it turned around. Who do you tell everything to?

title: Mission 08: Antares, the scorpion's heart.
old_caption: Scorpio flew to Antares to see its heart up close, with Taurus and a whole crate of snacks. It turned out to be a red supergiant, and the secret pink sock finally came out. What would you change for someone?

title: Mission: rescue the Seven Sisters.
old_caption: Taurus got an SOS about a missing Pleiades sister and set off slowly but surely, with snacks for seven. The cosmic stowaway stole a cookie. Who brings snacks to every rescue?

title: Mission 06: the Virgo Cluster.
old_caption: Virgo tried to label a cluster of over a thousand galaxies and ran out of tape at 47. Then Pisces pointed out the black hole that nobody could label. Virgo, what's the last thing you tried to organize?

title: Scorpios aren't jealous. They're all in.
old_caption:
Is it jealousy, or are you just all in?
Scorpio learns the real move: put the phone down and trust.

title: Wanting alone time isn't a red flag.
old_caption:
Need a night alone and feel guilty about it?
Space refills you. Just say when you'll be back.

title: Aquarius isn't cold. It's just thinking.
old_caption:
Ever been called cold when you were just deep in thought?
Aquarius cares. Sometimes it just shows up as a hand-drawn star map.

title: Aries isn't impatient. It's excited.
old_caption:
Aries bouncing by the door while you find your other shoe?
Excitement is sweet. So is letting someone catch up.

title: Austin is overrated for dating.
old_caption:
Is any city really bad for dating?
The stars rule: no city is overrated. Bad dates are.
